question: By what means does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of Kaula?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas.
The speaker claims to have become known or to have known through grace.
That knowledge is of the determination of Kaula.
The means cited is the grace of the addressee.
inference: By the grace of the lord of Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of Kaula.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of Kaula.
